# Fragment Lua API - Complete Reference
# Version 1.1
# Generated Documentation

This is the complete reference for the Fragment Lua scripting API.

## GETTING STARTED

Fragment provides a powerful Lua scripting engine with:
- Game object manipulation (Instance system)
- Low-level drawing (shapes, text, lines)
- Interactive UI widgets
- Global services (Players, Workspace, Lighting, RunService, UserInputService, HttpService, TweenService)
- Task scheduling (task library) and input reading (input library)
- Vector/transform types (Vector3, Vector2, Color3, CFrame)
- Bitwise operations (bit32 library)
- Signal/connection system (Connect/Disconnect/Fire, RenderStepped, Heartbeat, GetPropertyChangedSignal)

All Lua code runs in a sandboxed environment with external emulation of Roblox-like APIs.

---

## LUA VM - Script Execution

Namespace: lua_vm

### bool initialize()
Initializes the Lua virtual machine.
Returns: true if successful, false otherwise.
Must be called before executing any scripts.

### void shutdown()
Gracefully shuts down the Lua VM and releases resources.

### bool is_ready()
Checks if the Lua VM is initialized and ready.
Returns: true if ready, false otherwise.

### bool execute_string(const std::string& script, const std::string& chunk_name = "lua_script")
Executes Lua code from a string.
Parameters:
  - script (string): Lua code to execute
  - chunk_name (string, optional): Debug name for the code chunk
Returns: true if execution succeeded, false on error.

### bool execute_file(const std::filesystem::path& file_path)
Executes Lua code from a file.
Parameters:
  - file_path (path): Full path to .lua file
Returns: true if execution succeeded, false if file not found or has errors.

### void on_frame(float delta_time)
Called every frame to update Lua state. Call from your main game loop.
Parameters:
  - delta_time (float): Time elapsed since last frame in seconds

### void render_editor_window(bool menu_has_frame, const ImVec2& menu_pos, const ImVec2& menu_size)
Renders the Lua editor window in ImGui.
Parameters:
  - menu_has_frame (bool): Whether the menu has a frame
  - menu_pos (ImVec2): Position on screen
  - menu_size (ImVec2): Size of the window

### void render_console_window(bool menu_has_frame, const ImVec2& menu_pos, const ImVec2& menu_size)
Renders the Lua console window in ImGui.

---

## INSTANCE SYSTEM - Game Objects

Namespace: sandbox

All game objects inherit from the instance base class.
Instances form a hierarchical parent-child tree structure.

### Basic Properties

std::string get_name() const
Gets the instance name.

void set_name(const std::string& name)
Sets the instance name.

std::string get_class_name() const
Gets the class type name.

### Parent-Child Hierarchy

std::shared_ptr<instance> get_parent() const
Gets the parent instance.
Returns: Parent instance or nullptr if no parent exists.

bool set_parent(const std::shared_ptr<instance>& parent)
Sets the parent instance.
Prevents circular/cyclic relationships.
Returns: false if operation would create a cycle.

std::vector<std::shared_ptr<instance>> get_children() const
Gets all direct children of this instance.

std::vector<std::shared_ptr<instance>> get_descendants() const
Gets all descendants recursively (children, grandchildren, etc).

### Finding Instances

std::shared_ptr<instance> find_first_child(const std::string& name) const
Finds first direct child by name.
Returns: Child instance or nullptr if not found.

std::shared_ptr<instance> find_first_descendant(const std::string& name) const
Finds first descendant at any depth by name.
Returns: Descendant instance or nullptr if not found.

bool is_descendant_of(const std::shared_ptr<instance>& ancestor) const
Checks if this instance is a descendant of another.
Returns: true if is a descendant.

bool is_ancestor_of(const std::shared_ptr<instance>& descendant) const
Checks if this instance is an ancestor of another.
Returns: true if is an ancestor.

std::shared_ptr<instance> wait_for_child(const std::string& name, double timeout_seconds)
Waits for a child to appear with optional timeout.
Parameters:
  - name (string): Name of child to wait for
  - timeout_seconds (double): Maximum wait time in seconds
Returns: Child instance or nullptr if timeout expires.

### Attributes

void set_attribute(const std::string& key, const attribute_value& value)
Sets an attribute. Supported types: bool, double, string, null, Vector3, Color3, CFrame.

std::optional<attribute_value> get_attribute(const std::string& key) const
Gets an attribute value.
Returns: Optional containing value if exists, empty optional otherwise.

std::unordered_map<std::string, attribute_value> get_attributes() const
Gets all attributes.
Returns: Map of key-value pairs.

### Properties & Events

instance.prop = value / instance.prop
Instances can store and read typed properties by direct indexing. Types: boolean, number, string, Vector2, Vector3, Color3, CFrame.

GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop)
Returns a signal that fires when the property is changed via Lua.
Example:
local sinal = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position")
sinal:Connect(function() print("changed") end)

---

## DRAWING API - Rendering Primitives

Namespace: lua_drawing

### Drawing Objects

std::shared_ptr<drawing_object> create_object(const std::string& type_name)
Creates a drawable object.
Parameters:
  - type_name (string): "square", "text", or "line"
Returns: Pointer to created drawing_object or nullptr on failure.

std::shared_ptr<drawing_object> find_object(int object_id)
Finds a drawable object by ID.
Returns: Pointer to object or nullptr if not found.

bool remove_object(int object_id)
Removes a drawable object.
Returns: true if removed, false otherwise.

void clear_all()
Removes all drawable objects.

void render_all()
Renders all visible drawable objects to screen.

### Drawing Object Properties

All drawable objects have these properties:

id (int): Unique identifier
type (object_type): Type of drawing object
removed (bool): Whether the object is removed
visible (bool): Show/hide flag
color (color_value): RGBA color
transparency (float): Alpha transparency (0.0 - 1.0)
thickness (float): Line/border thickness
z_index (int): Drawing order (higher = on top)
position (vector2_value): X, Y screen coordinates
size (vector2_value): Width and height
filled (bool): Whether shape is filled
text (string): Text content (for text objects)
text_size (float): Font size in pixels
center (bool): Center alignment for text
from (vector2_value): Start point for lines
to (vector2_value): End point for lines

### Structures

struct color_value
{
	float r = 1.0f;   // Red (0.0 - 1.0)
	float g = 1.0f;   // Green (0.0 - 1.0)
	float b = 1.0f;   // Blue (0.0 - 1.0)
	float a = 1.0f;   // Alpha (0.0 - 1.0)
};

struct vector2_value
{
	float x = 0.0f;
	float y = 0.0f;
};

enum class object_type
{
	unknown,
	square,
	text,
	line
};

### Lua Drawing (what scripts actually use)

Drawing objects are created with Drawing.new("square"|"text"|"line") and rendered AUTOMATICALLY every frame — there is no render call in Lua. Use cleardrawcache() to clear everything.

Lua property names are capitalized: Visible, Position, Size, Color, Filled, Thickness, Text, TextSize, Center, Transparency, ZIndex, From, To.
All vector/color tables here are POSITIONAL:
- Position/Size/From/To = {x, y}  (index 1 = x, index 2 = y)
- Color = {r, g, b, a}            (indexes 1..4)

Example:
local box = Drawing.new("square")
box.Position = {200, 200}        -- {x, y}
box.Size = {100, 60}
box.Color = {1, 0, 0, 1}         -- {r, g, b, a}
box.Thickness = 2
box.Filled = true
task.delay(3, function()
    box:Remove()
end)

Global cleardrawcache() removes all drawing objects from the screen.

---

## UI WIDGET SYSTEM - Interactive Controls

Namespace: lua_ui

### Tab Management

int create_tab(const std::string& name)
Creates a new UI tab.
Returns: Tab ID or negative value on failure.

bool remove_tab(int tab_id)
Removes a tab and all its widgets.
Returns: true if successful.

bool set_tab_name(int tab_id, const std::string& name)
Renames a tab.
Returns: true if successful.

bool find_tab_id_by_name(const std::string& name, int& out_tab_id)
Finds a tab by name.
Returns: true if found, false otherwise.

std::vector<tab_descriptor> get_tabs_snapshot()
Gets all current tabs.
Returns: Vector of tab descriptors.

void clear_tab_widgets(int tab_id)
Removes all widgets from a tab.

### Widget Types

CHECKBOX: bool add_checkbox_widget(tab_id, key, label, default_value)
SLIDER: bool add_slider_widget(tab_id, key, label, min_val, max_val, default_val)
DROPDOWN: bool add_dropdown_widget(tab_id, key, label, options, default_index)
MULTI_DROPDOWN: bool add_multi_dropdown_widget(tab_id, key, label, options, default_values)
KEYBIND: bool add_keybind_widget(tab_id, key, label, default_key, default_mode)
COLORPICKER: bool add_colorpicker_widget(tab_id, key, label, default_color)
BUTTON: bool add_button_widget(tab_id, key, label, callback_ref)
INPUT_TEXT: bool add_input_text_widget(tab_id, key, label, default_value)

All widget creation functions return true on success, false on failure.

### Widget Values

bool get_widget_value(int tab_id, const std::string& key, widget_value& out_value)
Gets the current value of a widget.
Returns: true if found, false otherwise.

bool set_widget_value(int tab_id, const std::string& key, const widget_value& in_value)
Sets a widget's value.
Returns: true if successful.

void render_tab_widgets(int tab_id)
Renders all widgets in a tab.

std::vector<int> take_pending_button_callbacks()
Gets all buttons clicked this frame.

### Structures

enum class widget_type
{
	checkbox,
	slider,
	dropdown,
	multi_dropdown,
	keybind,
	colorpicker,
	button,
	input_text
};

enum class value_type
{
	none,
	boolean,
	number,
	integer,
	string,
	color,
	keybind,
	boolean_list
};

struct widget_value
{
	value_type type;
	bool bool_value;
	float number_value;
	int int_value;
	std::string string_value;
	color_value color;
	keybind_value keybind;
	std::vector<bool> bool_list_value;
};

struct tab_descriptor
{
	int id;
	std::string name;
};

struct keybind_value
{
	int key;        // Virtual key code
	int mode;       // Binding mode
	bool enabled;   // Active state
};

---

## SERVICES - Game Systems

Namespace: sandbox

### Players Service
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_players_service()
Access player management and information.

### Workspace Service
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_workspace_service()
Access the game world and environment.

### RunService
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_run_service()
Frame-based event handling and timing.

### Lighting Service
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_lighting_service()
Lighting and visual effects control.

### UserInputService
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_user_input_service()
Keyboard/mouse/touch state and mouse location.
Lua access: game:GetService("UserInputService")
Methods: IsKeyDown(keycode), GetMouseLocation(), properties MouseEnabled, KeyboardEnabled, TouchEnabled.

### HttpService
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_http_service()
HTTP requests and GUID generation.
Lua access: game:GetService("HttpService")
Methods: GetAsync(url), PostAsync(url, body, content_type, ...), Request(request_table), GenerateGUID(use_brackets).
Global aliases: request(request_table), http_request(request_table), HttpGet(url).

### TweenService
std::shared_ptr<instance> create_tween_service()
Create and control property animations.
Lua access: game:GetService("TweenService")
Method: Create(instance, tween_info_table, goal_properties) -> tween
The tween_info_table accepts: Time (seconds), EasingStyle, EasingDirection, RepeatCount, Reverses.
Tween object methods/properties: Play(), Pause(), Cancel(), Duration (seconds), PlaybackState ("Playing"/"Completed"), Instance. There is no Resume(); to continue use Play().

All services inherit from the instance base class.

---

## ATTRIBUTE DATA TYPE

using attribute_value = std::variant<std::monostate, bool, double, std::string, vector3_value, color3_value, cframe_value>;

Supported attribute types:
- std::monostate: Null or empty value
- bool: Boolean true/false
- double: Numeric floating-point value
- std::string: Text string
- vector3_value: {x, y, z}
- color3_value: {r, g, b}
- cframe_value: {x, y, z, R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22}

---

## GLOBAL FUNCTIONS

Global-level functions added to the Lua environment:

- print(...), warn(...): console output
- loadstring(script): compile string as function
- identifyexecutor(): executor name
- getgenv(): table of the global environment
- getmousepos(): current mouse position as a POSITIONAL table {x, y}; access x as pos[1], y as pos[2] (do NOT use pos.x/pos.y)
- isrbxactive(): whether the target window is active
- iskeypressed(keycode): whether a key is down
- cleardrawcache(): clear drawing cache
- spawn(fn) / spawn(fn, ...args): run function in a new thread
- wait(seconds): yield for a duration
- getrawkeys(t): get all keys of a table without __pairs metamethod
- rawget(t, key), rawset(t, key, value): raw table access
- request(info) / http_request(info): HTTP request (see HttpService.Request)
- HttpGet(url): synchronous GET returning body

---

## TASK & INPUT LIBRARIES

### task
- task.delay(seconds, fn, ...): call fn after delay
- task.wait(seconds): yield and resume after duration
- task.spawn(fn, ...): run function in a new thread
- task.defer(fn, ...): run function in a deferred thread

### input
- input.mouse_position(): current mouse position as a POSITIONAL table {x, y} (access x as pos[1], y as pos[2])
- input.is_key_down(keycode): whether a key is held down

---

## DATA TYPES

### Vector3
- Vector3.new(x, y, z): create a vector
- Properties: x, y, z
- Attribute form: {x = ..., y = ..., z = ...}

### Vector2
- Vector2.new(x, y): create a vector
- Properties: x, y
- Attribute form: {x = ..., y = ...}

### Color3
- Color3.new(r, g, b): create a color (0.0 - 1.0)
- Properties: r, g, b
- Attribute form: {r = ..., g = ..., b = ...}

### UDim / UDim2
- UDim.new(scale, offset): create a UDim (fields: scale, offset)
- UDim2.new(x_scale, x_offset, y_scale, y_offset): create a UDim2
- UDim2 fields: x_scale, x_offset, y_scale, y_offset (there are no X/Y sub-objects)

### CFrame
- CFrame.new(x, y, z): translation-only
- CFrame.new(x, y, z, R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22): full matrix
- CFrame.lookAt(from, to): look-at transform
- Properties: Position/P, RightVector, UpVector, BackVector, LookVector
- Methods: ToEulerAnglesXYZ() -> (x, y, z), Inverse(), plus (+), times (*)

---

## BIT32 LIBRARY

Bitwise operations on unsigned 32-bit integers:
- bit32.band(...), bit32.bor(...), bit32.bxor(...): AND/OR/XOR of multiple numbers
- bit32.bnot(x): NOT
- bit32.btest(...): returns true if all bits set
- bit32.lshift(x, disp), bit32.rshift(x, disp): logical shifts
- bit32.arshift(x, disp): arithmetic shift
- bit32.lrotate(x, disp), bit32.rrotate(x, disp): rotations
- bit32.extract(n, field, width): extract bits
- bit32.replace(n, v, field, width): replace bits
- bit32.tobit(x): normalize to 32-bit unsigned

---

## SIGNALS & CONNECTIONS

Lua access to events uses a unified connection system:
- signal.Connect(fn): returns a connection table
- connection:Disconnect(): stops the callback
- connection:Fire(...args): manually invoke the callback

Available signals:
- Players.PlayerAdded (arg: player)
- player.CharacterAdded (arg: character)
- RunService.RenderStepped (arg: delta_time)
- RunService.Heartbeat (arg: accumulated runtime seconds)
- instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property)

---

## COMMON PATTERNS

### Initialize and Execute Script (host C++ code)
if (lua_vm::initialize()) {
	lua_vm::execute_string("print('Hello')");
	lua_vm::on_frame(0.016f);  // ~60 FPS
	lua_vm::shutdown();
}

### Create UI Tab with Widgets (Lua)
local tab = ui.create_tab("Settings")
ui.checkbox(tab, "enabled", "Enable", true)
ui.slider(tab, "value", "Value", 0, 100, 50)
ui.button(tab, "go", "Go", function() print("clicked") end)

### Get Widget Value (Lua)
local enabled = ui.get(tab, "enabled")  -- boolean (checkbox)
local value = ui.get(tab, "value")      -- number (slider)
ui.set(tab, "value", 75)                -- update a widget (bool/number/string only)
-- Note: colorpicker, keybind and multi_dropdown values are NOT readable via ui.get (returns nil).

### Draw Shapes (Lua) - rendering is automatic
local box = Drawing.new("square")
box.Position = {100, 100}
box.Size = {150, 100}
box.Color = {1, 0, 0, 1}
box.Filled = false

### Follow the mouse (Lua) - positions are positional tables
local label = Drawing.new("text")
label.Text = "hi"
label.Center = true
game.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local m = input.mouse_position()
	label.Position = {m[1], m[2]}   -- NOT m.x / m.y
end)

### Create an Instance (Lua)
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "MyPart"
part.Position = Vector3.new(10, 5, 0)
part.Parent = workspace

### Access Instances (Lua)
local player = workspace:FindFirstChild("Player1")
if player then
	player:SetAttribute("health", 100)
	print(player:GetAttribute("health"))
end

### Animate Properties with TweenService (Lua)
local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
local part = game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("Part")
if part then
	local tween = ts:Create(part, {
		Time = 1.5,
		EasingStyle = "Quad",
		EasingDirection = "Out",
		RepeatCount = 0,
		Reverses = true
	}, {
		Position = Vector3.new(100, 50, 0)
	})
	tween:Play()
	print(tween.PlaybackState)  -- "Playing"
end

### Events & Connections (Lua)
game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	print("player joined:", player.Name)
end)

local conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	-- dt = seconds since last frame
end)
task.delay(5, function()
	conn:Disconnect()
end)

### HTTP Request (Lua)
local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local res = http:Request({
	Url = "https://example.com/api",
	Method = "GET",
	Headers = { ["Accept"] = "application/json" },
})
print(res.StatusCode, res.Body, res.StatusMessage)

---

## FRAGMENT LUA API QUICK REFERENCE

## Common Functions by Category

### Initialization & Execution
- lua_vm::initialize() → bool
- lua_vm::shutdown() → void
- lua_vm::is_ready() → bool
- lua_vm::execute_string(script, chunk_name) → bool
- lua_vm::execute_file(path) → bool
- lua_vm::on_frame(delta_time) → void

### Instance Navigation
- get_parent() → instance*
- set_parent(parent) → bool
- get_children() → vector<instance*>
- get_descendants() → vector<instance*>
- find_first_child(name) → instance*
- find_first_descendant(name) → instance*

### Instance Properties
- get_name() → string
- set_name(name) → void
- get_class_name() → string
- get_attribute(key) → optional<value>
- set_attribute(key, value) → void
- get_attributes() → map<string, value>

### Drawing
- create_object(type) → drawing_object*
- find_object(id) → drawing_object*
- remove_object(id) → bool
- render_all() → void
- clear_all() → void

### UI - Tabs
- create_tab(name) → int (tab_id)
- remove_tab(tab_id) → bool
- set_tab_name(tab_id, name) → bool
- get_tabs_snapshot() → vector<tab_descriptor>
- clear_tab_widgets(tab_id) → void

### UI - Widgets
- add_checkbox_widget(tab, key, label, default) → bool
- add_slider_widget(tab, key, label, min, max, default) → bool
- add_dropdown_widget(tab, key, label, options, index) → bool
- add_multi_dropdown_widget(tab, key, label, options, values) → bool
- add_keybind_widget(tab, key, label, key, mode) → bool
- add_colorpicker_widget(tab, key, label, color) → bool
- add_button_widget(tab, key, label, callback) → bool
- add_input_text_widget(tab, key, label, default) → bool

### UI - Values
- get_widget_value(tab, key, value) → bool
- set_widget_value(tab, key, value) → bool
- render_tab_widgets(tab) → void
- take_pending_button_callbacks() → vector<int>

### Services
- game:GetService("Players") → players_service*
- game:GetService("Workspace") → workspace_service*
- game:GetService("RunService") → run_service*
- game:GetService("Lighting") → lighting_service*
- game:GetService("UserInputService") → user_input_service*
- game:GetService("HttpService") → http_service*
- game:GetService("TweenService") → tween_service*

### Global Functions
- identifyexecutor() → string
- getmousepos() → {x, y} (pos[1], pos[2])
- isrbxactive() → bool
- iskeypressed(key) → bool
- cleardrawcache() → void
- spawn(fn, ...) → void
- wait(seconds) → void
- getrawkeys(t) → array
- rawget(t, key) / rawset(t, key, value)
- request(info) / http_request(info) → table
- HttpGet(url) → string
- getgenv() → table

### task & input
- task.delay(seconds, fn, ...) → void
- task.wait(seconds) → void
- task.spawn(fn, ...) → void
- task.defer(fn, ...) → void
- input.mouse_position() → {x, y} (pos[1], pos[2])
- input.is_key_down(keycode) → bool

### Data Types
- Vector3.new(x, y, z), Vector2.new(x, y), Color3.new(r, g, b)
- UDim.new(scale, offset), UDim2.new(x_scale, x_offset, y_scale, y_offset)
- CFrame.new(...), CFrame.lookAt(from, to)

### Instance Constructors & Drawing
- Instance.new(className) → inst (set inst.Parent to add to tree)
- Drawing.new("square"|"text"|"line") → drawing (rendered automatically each frame)

### bit32
- band, bor, bxor, bnot, btest, lshift, rshift, arshift, lrotate, rrotate, extract, replace, tobit

### Signals
- signal.Connect(fn) → connection
- connection:Disconnect() → void
- connection:Fire(...) → void
- GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop) → signal

---
